turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it: the zero went into the gradebook on November 3, my son found out on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I asked you a question, Hale. Who decided, and on what basis?
This meeting is over. I'm leaving.
Then I'm walking straight to the principal's office, and your own procedure 4.2 is coming with me. Sit down, Hale. Withdraw the zero, or tell me on what basis it's there.
Fine. I'm going to the principal's office now, and I'll want your basis for that zero in an email tonight. Owen hears nothing about this from you in front of his class.
Because the zero is still in the gradebook, Hale. Withdraw it, or give me one reason it's there.
